description_en: Queries the log delivery status of protected objects
description_zh: 查询防护对象日志外发投递状态
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-resource-log-delivery-status --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-g6z3z00000 --resources alb-wewbb23dfsetetcic1242-00000,test.waf.com-waf --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeResourceLogDeliveryStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The protected objects to query. Separate multiple protected objects with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的防护对象，多个防护对象用英文逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: resources

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

LogConfigs.description_en: The list of log delivery configurations for protected objects
LogConfigs.description_zh: 防护对象日志外发投递配置列表

items.description_en: The log delivery configuration for a protected object
items.description_zh: 防护对象日志外发投递配置

DeliveryName.description_en: The name of the delivery configuration

DeliveryType.description_en:
The delivery type of the protected object. Valid values:

syslog: delivered to a syslog service.
kafka: delivered to a Kafka service
DeliveryType.description_zh:
防护对象外发投递类型。取值为：

syslog：表示外发投递到syslog服务。
kafka：表示外发投递到kafka服务

Status.description_en:
The log delivery status of the protected object. Valid values:

true: enabled.

false: disabled
Status.description_zh:
防护对象日志外发投递状态。取值：

true：表示已开启。

false：表示关闭
